analysis.scoreReason: RSI 과매도 탈출 + 5일 저가 20일 저가 상회
analysis.scoreReasonEn: RSI exiting oversold + 5-day low above 20-day low
analysis.reason: 직전 매수 진입 후 3거래일 연속 하락했으나, RSI 37.9로 과매도 구간 진입. 5일 저가(1092000)가 20일 저가(1089000)를 상회하며 기술적 반등 가능성 확인. MACD 히스토그램은 악화 중이나, RSI와 가격 패턴이 매수 신호 제시.
analysis.reasonEn: Despite three consecutive days of decline after the previous buy entry, RSI at 37.9 indicates oversold conditions. The 5-day low (1,092,000) surpassing the 20-day low (1,089,000) confirms potential for a technical rebound. Although MACD histogram is worsening, RSI and price pattern suggest a buy signal.

analysis.weeklyConflictEn: Weekly RSI is 39.0 (bearish), but daily oversold exit signal takes precedence.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (1,113,000 KRW) vs SMA5 (1,131,600 KRW)/SMA20 (1,273,100 KRW)/SMA50 (1,490,980 KRW): Below short/mid-term trends, indicating bearish position.
· Position relative to SMA100 (1,655,628 KRW)/SMA200 (1,528,524 KRW): Below long-term trends, confirming bearish strength.
· 52-week position (30.7%) + Current price level near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (40.1→37.9) + Entered oversold territory + Continuing downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (314.0351→-1743.5036) + Worsening diagnosis + Signal of continued bearish trend.
· Bollinger Bands current price position (near lower band 1,006,167 KRW) + Bandwidth at 41.93%, approaching lower band.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (1,089,000 KRW) + Support based on 20-day low.
· Swing resistance (1,317,000 KRW) + Potential for mid-term trend reversal upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low + 5-day low above 20-day low) + Rebound signal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.95x) + Normal level of confidence in movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Attempting technical rebound within a downtrend) + Buy entry conditions met.

analysis.continuityEn: After maintaining a wait-and-see stance for the previous three consecutive sessions, a shift to buy today is based on RSI exiting oversold territory and the 5-day low surpassing the 20-day low. Technical rebound signals are prioritized despite the worsening MACD histogram.
